en.ui.rotate_tool.angle: Rotate: click to set the angle, or type it in degrees and press Enter. Tap Ctrl to copy.
en.ui.rotate_tool.bad_angle: Rotate: type the angle as a number of degrees.
en.ui.rotate_tool.center: Rotate: click the centre of rotation. Arrow keys lock the axis to X, Y or Z.
en.ui.rotate_tool.nothing: Rotate: select what to rotate, or click on it.
en.ui.rotate_tool.start: Rotate: click the start of the angle.

ja.ui.rotate_tool.bad_angle: 回転: 角度を度数の数値で入力してください。
